location.label: Los Angeles
location.detail: building VivanceData and taking on a few AI consulting projects.

building.title: VivanceData
building.note: AI for construction, HVAC, logistics and manufacturing: after-hours calls answered and booked, permits and delivery paperwork read instead of re-keyed.

building.title: Monkey SMP
building.note: A modded Minecraft server for friends, with one installer for every platform and a server that updates itself overnight. Season I opens on 21 November.

building.title: Hollow Crown
building.note: A rooftop stealth game in Godot about robbing the crown to keep a village alive. Still greybox, with a ten-night roguelite mode taking shape.

building.title: The repo fleet
building.note: 78 repositories in the registry, 42 of them with scheduled agents that open pull requests rather than pushing. merge-gate decides what merges; I review what it holds back.

building.title: A five-song EP
building.note: Recording now. It will be on the music page when it is out.

thinkingAbout: Whether self-hosting is a technical preference or a political one, and what changes if it is the second.
How much of what gets called productivity is really just legibility to someone else.
Tools that degrade gracefully when the company behind them disappears.
Why the interesting part of a recommendation system is what it refuses to show you.
